biggest_catch: This is a $1,000 bonus, but it requires parking $25,000 for 90 consecutive days — a single day under $25,000 kills the entire bonus. It also requires a banker appointment to open (no purely online path), and the $25 monthly fee kicks in from month 3 unless you keep $7,500+ average ledger balance or $20,000+ in combined KeyBank balances.
catches: Park $25,000 or more for 90 CONSECUTIVE days — if the end-of-day balance falls below $25,000 even once during the 90-day maintenance period, you no longer qualify. That's a hard cliff, not a tier.

Opened via a banker appointment — KeyBank's footprint covers AK, CO, CT, ID, IN, ME, MA, MI, NY, OH, OR, PA, UT, VT, WA (per deal-site coverage; confirm branch availability with KeyBank). No purely online application path is described.

Key Business Reward Checking has a $25 monthly maintenance service charge, waived only for the first two months; from month 3 it's avoidable with a $7,500+ average ledger balance, $20,000+ combined balances/loans, or a Key Merchant Services subscription.
New business customers only: the business entity (SSN/EIN) must not have had a KeyBank business checking or business savings account in the past 12 months.
One account-opening offer per qualifying account and one per business entity (SSN/EIN); KeyBank employees/affiliates not eligible.
Account must not be closed at the time of bonus payment; bonus is reported on Form 1099-INT (taxable).
Offer subject to cancellation without notice — open before the 11/6/2026 deadline rather than waiting.
Like other bank bonuses, expect the bonus to be reported as taxable interest income (confirm at tax time).
